author: TeIq
content: Origin: #28 audit. polaris-backend/src/config.rs line 709 declares `pub enum LabelerSigningKeyConfig` with `#[serde(tag = "mode", rename_all = "kebab-case")]`. Variant `CloudKms { ... }` renders as kebab `cloud-kms`, but the deserializer-supplementary code (line 639) and the test JSON (line 823) both use `cloud-kms-oracle` as the tag. Test `labeler_signing_key_config_deserialises_each_mode` is currently failing on this. Fix: `#[serde(rename = "cloud-kms-oracle")]` directly on the `CloudKms` variant, OR rename the variant to `CloudKmsOracle` (the latter matches the design doc's mode name and is cleaner). Single-line fix.
